_comment: Wave-1 Layer-2.1 baseline tsconfig. We do NOT compile any TypeScript yet — the codebase is still .js. This config gives us tsc --noEmit JSDoc type-checking on files that opt in via '// @ts-check', so we catch typos / wrong arity / undefined vars / wrong-type calls without changing the runtime shape of any file. Once Layer 2.2+ converts files to real .ts (or .mts), this same config picks them up.
_includeNote: Only the wave-1-L2.1 pilot files are listed below + the ambient types/*.d.ts. Every other .js file is currently ignored — they'll be added as they get checked-and-typed in subsequent layers.
